Hardware Notes: Standard EFR32xG24 Explorer Kit (xG24-EK2703A) board configuration. Integrated SEGGER J-Link OB used for flashing and serial-over-USB. Core clocked at 78 MHz; 3.3 V VDD supplied through the J-Link USB. The SoC integrates a Silicon Labs MVP (Matrix Vector Processor) accelerator, used by the DeepGate compiler for operator offload.
Inference Framework: DeepGate libmodel (precompiled per-(board, task) static library)
Software Notes: Compiler reachable via DeepGate's online platform at https://bitweaver.deepgate.ai (see Quantization Method section for the technique).
Quantization Method: Per-tensor int8. For ic01, ic02, vww01, and ad01 we use the benchmark owner's supplied int8 reference TFLite directly (bit-identical weights). For KWS01 we re-quantize from the fp32 reference using post-training quantization (PTQ) on the official calibration set. Full description in this submission's README.md, section 'Quantization method'.
